transcript: Aaj mai tumhe batata hu ki website kaise bana sakte ho Google Maps ke sath. Is video ko save karlo kyunki poora process bata raha hu step-by-step. Sabse pehle Google Maps khol lo aur saare jo bhi tumhe aas-paas cafes dikh rahe hain, usme se ek cafe choose karo. Phir select karne ke baad jo bhi details tumhe dikh rahi hai na, wo saari details copy karo aur ChatGPT pe daalo. ChatGPT tumhe proper ek prompt dega jo tum Emergent pe daaloge, aur Emergent ek full stack website bana ke tumhe de dega. Aur wo website phir tum aaram se 50 se 60 hazar rupaye tak bech sakte ho. Comment kar dena "FULL STACK" ya phir "AI", mai tumhe proper guide de dunga, tab tak ke liye Jai Mata Di, milta hu tumse next video me.
